modeling.site_brand: varies by host site (e.g. Afriquia, malls, hotels); do not equate site brand with CPO

cpo_attribution.finding: FastVolt's official About page explicitly describes FastVolt as the operator launched by Afrimobility, providing fast and semi-fast EV charging services through its network in Morocco. This is station-network operator evidence and is stronger than inferring the CPO from app publisher/support metadata.

network_scope.finding: FastVolt states that it operates the largest EV charging network in Morocco with more than 100 charging points and DC charging up to 100 kW.

tariffs.finding: Public direct tariff page states parking with fast DC charging at 2.50 MAD/min and semi-fast AC charging at 0.50 MAD/min.

connector_types.finding: Official FAQ states Type 2 for AC and CCS2 for DC; CHAdeMO is not supported across the full network.

native_status_semantics.finding: Official FAQ says each charging point displays real-time state in the FastVolt app: available, occupied, or out of service.

public_map.finding: A public charging-point map exists and renders many fast/semi-fast charger markers, but this pass still did not validate a machine-readable anonymous station endpoint behind it.

app_provenance.finding: Google Play lists the FastVolt app from Afri Mobility and exposes tech@evplug.ma as app support, documenting a real EVPlug technical relationship without changing CPO attribution.

tcc_assessment.tariff_scope_warning: Treat 2.50 MAD/min DC and 0.50 MAD/min AC as FastVolt direct public tariffs unless station-specific evidence overrides them.
tcc_assessment.current_blocker: FastVolt native mobile station route remains protected by Business/Organisation client context; the public website map has not yet yielded a validated anonymous station endpoint.
